visualCharacteristics.summary: Small coloured box sharing a section: a stat tile (icon, big number, caption), a one-line tagline strip, an at-a-glance summary panel, a linked icon tile, or a dark note box.

contentPattern.structure: Free-form rows/cells: an optional icon or picture, then heading / text / links. Pictures are collected into the media area, everything else into the body in authored order.

usage: Default: stat / highlight tile (icon, heading, caption). tagline: 'Safe | Simple | Fast' strip on business-banking heroes. summary: 'At a Glance' panel in blog articles. shadow: clickable icon tile (e.g. RBI Notifications). blue: dark note box on investor pages.

notSuitableFor: grids of many cards (use cards / product-cards)
